status_meaning: Execution, data-contract and identity checks passed; no accuracy threshold

weighting.aggregation: Sum SAE/SSE/count, then MAE=SAE/count and RMSE=sqrt(SSE/count)
weighting.repeated_targets: Count every forecast assignment; no independence claim

scientific_scope.evaluation_population: selected training families only; not heldout generalization

identity_audit.scope: Selected manifests and accessed batches; no MPH/native-bin read
